integrity: The theorem is proved from the published dual-pgf differential identity plus an exact integer moment inequality. Finite rational checks support, but do not replace, the analytic proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite variance requires a dual law with finite second moment. Classical continuous-time branching literature contains generic moment evolution, and full text of the two cited 1968 embedding papers was not available in the bounded lawful-access search, leaving a residual risk of an equivalent older extremal formulation.
title: Sharp dispersion frontier for composition-closed stopping models
